text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Toronto and East York Community Council, at its meeting on February 24, 2021, approved the subject construction staging areas on Strathmore Avenue and Dewhurst Boulevard, from February 25, 2021 to April 26, 2021. The purpose of this report is to respond to a number of requests made by Toronto and East York Community Council of the General Manager, Transportation Services, regarding the construction staging areas and to receive approval for the construction staging areas until January 31, 2023.
